settings.text: 1. Is this hair styler suitable for thick, curly hair?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Absolutely! Le Titane was created to a…
settings.text: Absolutely! Le Titane was created to accommodate all hair types and it’s ideal for thick, coarse or curly hair types. With closer plates at 0.3mm, even the thickest hair types will achieve even heat distribution and silky smooth results.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 2. What are the benefits of the infrar…
settings.text: 2. What are the benefits of the infrared heat strip?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Le Titane utilizes infrared heat strip…
settings.text: Le Titane utilizes infrared heat strips to ensure even heat distribution and promote gentle styling. The infrared strip is featured on the center of the floating titanium plates and heats up in under a minute.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 3. What is the benefit of a tulip-shap…
settings.text: 3. What is the benefit of a tulip-shaped cool tip? How does it make this tool safer?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This unique, tulip-shaped tip is the s…
settings.text: This unique, tulip-shaped tip is the secret to enhancing safety during use and preventing the risk of burns during styling. Straighten, wave, or curl 100% stress-free.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 4. What kind of curls can I create usi…
settings.text: 4. What kind of curls can I create using Le Titane?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It’s completely up to you! Show off yo…
settings.text: It’s completely up to you! Show off your unique style with Le Titane. Depending on the section size of hair used and movements with the iron, Le Titane can create beautiful beach waves, tight curls, or bouncy waves that mimic the look of a roller set. The soft-touch ergonomic design makes it easy to create a style you love.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 5. What is the temperature memory func…
settings.text: 5. What is the temperature memory function?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · With Le Titane, we’re all about ease o…
settings.text: With Le Titane, we’re all about ease of use! Once you select your heat setting using the digital temperature control dial and display, the device will automatically return to this temperature the next time it is powered on.
